- What is CRM pricing and how is it determined? What factors affect CRM software cost? CRM pricing refers to the cost of implementing and using customer relationship management software. The price is determined by factors like number of users, features included in the software, integrations and level of support provided by CRM companies.
- How much does a CRM cost on average? CRM costs vary widely depending on the CRM company and features included. On average, the typical cost of CRM software ranges from less than a hundred to several hundred dollars per user per year, with some enterprise-level solutions costing even more. To find the best CRM software prices, research and compare CRM providers based on their pricing plans and features. Pipedrive offers different solutions at price points to match users’ requirements. Learn more on our CRM price comparison pages.
- Can my co-workers join my free trial? Yes, you can invite as many people as you want to join your Pipedrive trial. Simply click on your profile in the top right corner of your screen and select “Add more users” from the drop-down menu.
- Will my data be safe? Protecting your business data is one of our highest priorities. Learn more about our rigorous security and privacy standards.
- What is an add-on? Add-ons are additional Pipedrive tools that you can add to any plan.
- What’s the difference between annual and monthly billing? The difference is how often you pay your subscription fee. With monthly billing, you will be charged on the same day each month. With annual billing, you are charged once for the whole year.
- Which payment methods do you accept? There are different ways to pay for Pipedrive including major credit cards, debit cards and PayPal. Your payment options depend on the country you live in.
- How can I contact customer support? Our friendly support team is ready to help out. Here’s how to get in touch.
- What are the prices associated with CRM? As well as the cost of the customer relationship management software itself, which differs based on pricing tier, some providers also charge users for implementation, setup, training, data migration, support and more. You may also be able to purchase credits to get access to more features or more access to the features already on your plan. Try to find a CRM that’s transparent about its pricing. Pipedrive has no hidden costs, making it an excellent choice for anyone with a fixed budget.
- What does it cost to implement a CRM? The cost of implementing a CRM varies based on factors such as business size, software choice, user count, customization and integration needs. On-premises setups usually have higher upfront costs. Some CRM providers charge users for implementation. If you choose Pipedrive, implementation is free when you sign up for a pricing plan that’s over $400 a year. Costs differ widely, so a thorough evaluation is essential for an accurate estimate.

title: Knowledge Base
text:
## How does pricing work in Pipedrive?

JT

Jenny Takahara

Last updated: September 3, 2026

Note: Only users with account settings access rights can manage Pipedrive billing. Learn more about user management in this article.

Pipedrive offers four pricing plans to fit teams of any size: Lite, Growth, Premium and Ultimate. You can further customize your subscription with optional add-ons and top-ups.

To view and edit your current subscription, open the account menu in the top-right corner and go to Billing.

---

## Pipedrive plans and billing cycles

To change your plan, click** “Manage subscription”**, then select “All plans” to see all available options.

Once you’ve chosen your plan, select your preferred billing cycle in the same view:

Here’s how the billing cycles differ:

| Billing cycle | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Monthly | You’ll pay on the same day each month |
| Annual | You’ll pay upfront for the entire year and receive a discount |

---

## Add-ons

You can enhance your plan with optional add-ons that provide access to additional tools like prospecting, document management and email marketing. Add-ons are billed according to the billing cycle of your selected plan.

Note: Only Premium and Ultimate plans include some add-ons at no additional cost.

| Add-on | Lite | Growth | Premium | Ultimate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| LeadBooster | Add-on | Add-on | Included | Included |
| Projects | Add-on | Add-on | Included | Included |
| Smart Docs | Add-on | Add-on | Included | Included |
| Campaigns | Add-on | Add-on | Add-on | Add-on |
| Web Visitors | Add-on | Add-on | Add-on | Add-on |

...

## Top-ups

If you’ve reached the limits of your current plan, but don’t want to upgrade, you can purchase top-ups to increase specific usage limits. Top-ups follow your plan's billing cycle.

| Top-up type | Top-up quantity | Maximum | Available from |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| API tokens (max. 100 million per company) | +250,000 | 10 | Growth plan |
| Leads + Deals (max. 300,000 per company) | +25,000 | 10 | Growth plan |
| Reports | +50 | 10 | Growth plan |
| Automations | +50 | 10 | Growth plan |
| Data enrichment credits | +100 | 10,000 | Premium plan |
| Prospector credits | +10 | 1000 | Premium plan |
| Teams | +10 | 10 | Premium plan |
| Custom visibility groups | +10 | 10 | Premium plan |
| Custom permission sets | +10 | 10 | Premium plan |

Note: Teams, visibility groups and permission sets are included in one bundled team management top-up.

...

## What affects your total subscription cost

Your total cost depends on a few key factors:

- Selected plan – Each plan (Lite, Growth, Premium, Ultimate) has its own base price per seat
- Billing cycle – You can choose between annual or monthly billing
- Number of seats – You’re charged per seat, whether it’s assigned to a user or not. Learn more about seats and users.
- Add-ons and top-ups – Optional features and usage extensions that follow your plan's billing cycle
- Currency and location – Your location determines the billing currency and available payment methods

For example, if you’re on the Growth annual plan with four seats and the LeadBooster add-on, your total would be:

4 seats × Growth annual plan price + LeadBooster add-on price

| Feature | Advanced | Growth |

Note: If you’re currently above the Advanced plan’s limits, switching allows you to keep your data without disruption.

### How to switch from Advanced to Growth?

Go to Billing > Manage subscription in your account settings.

Note: Switching to Growth will update your subscription to Pipedrive**’s** latest list pricing.

- Qu'est-ce que le prix d'un CRM et comment est-il déterminé ? Quels facteurs influent sur le coût d'un logiciel CRM ? Le prix d'un CRM représente le coût de l'installation et de l'utilisation d'un logiciel de gestion de la relation client. Ce prix est déterminé par des facteurs tels que le nombre d'utilisateurs, les fonctionnalités comprises dans le logiciel, les intégrations et le niveau d'assistance assuré par les fournisseurs de CRM.
- Combien coûte un CRM en moyenne ? Les tarifs d'un CRM varient du tout au tout en fonction de la société qui l'édite et des fonctionnalités incluses. Généralement, le prix d'un logiciel CRM se situe entre moins de cent dollars et plusieurs centaines de dollars par utilisateur et par an, les solutions destinées aux grandes entreprises pouvant atteindre des prix encore plus élevés. Pour trouver le meilleur prix pour un logiciel CRM, recherchez et comparez les concepteurs et leurs produits sur la base de leurs formules d'abonnement et de leurs fonctionnalités. ... Pour en savoir plus, consultez nos pages de comparaison des prix des CRM.
- Mes collaborateurs peuvent-ils rejoindre mon essai gratuit ? Oui, vous pouvez inviter autant de coéquipiers que vous voulez à se joindre à votre essai Pipedrive.

...

- Qu'est-ce qu'une extension ? Les extensions sont des outils Pipedrive supplémentaires que vous pouvez ajouter à n'importe quel plan.
- Quelle différence y a-t-il entre les facturations annuelle et mensuelle ? La différence réside dans la fréquence de paiement de votre abonnement. Avec une facturation mensuelle, vous êtes débité le même jour de chaque mois. Avec une facturation annuelle, vous êtes débité une seule fois pour toute l'année.
- Quels modes de paiement acceptez-vous ? Pour régler votre abonnement Pipedrive, vous avez le choix entre différentes modalités de paiement, notamment les principales cartes de crédit et de débit, ainsi que PayPal. Vos options de paiement dépendent de votre pays de résidence.
- Comment contacter l'assistance client ? Notre équipe d'assistance est à votre disposition. Voici comment la contacter.
- Quels sont les prix associés à un CRM ? En plus du prix du logiciel de gestion de la relation client proprement dit, qui change suivant le niveau d'abonnement, certains fournisseurs facturent également l'installation, la configuration, la formation, la migration de données, l'assistance, etc.

...

Certains fournisseurs de CRM facturent la mise en œuvre aux utilisateurs.
